verdict.rationale: Fivetran is documented as a fully managed SaaS platform. Its Hybrid Deployment model lets customers run a Hybrid Deployment Agent on their own hosts, with configuration parameters, systemd management and multiple connections per agent. Those agents are still created and managed from the Fivetran-hosted dashboard, so only the data plane is self-hosted, and community comments contrast Fivetran with self-hostable Airbyte. Missing for 10: a fully self-hosted control plane/core product, open-source or on-prem distribution of the platform, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
